neighbours.label: inside a yes/no question that challenges or seeks confirmation (Are you sure you want…, Was it wrong that…)
fire: "Are you sure you need all of these boxes?" she asked.
Do you really think he will come back tomorrow?
Was it right of them to leave the dog behind?
Are you certain you locked the front door?
Is it really worth driving all that way for one meeting?
Did you honestly believe nobody would notice?
Are you sure this is the road to the village?
Is it wrong to feel relieved that it is over?
quiet: "You need all of these boxes," she said.
I think he will come back tomorrow.
They decided to leave the dog behind.
I locked the front door before we left.
It is worth driving all that way for one meeting.
You believed that nobody would notice.
This is the road to the village.
I feel relieved that it is over.
